Maya R.: heads-up — noticed a sustained p95 latency jump on kv-proxy around 01:12 UTC. I opened a rollback PR that reverts the recent connpool tweak so we can get latencies back down. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4621 Can someone quick-review + approve? This is a hotfix candidate.

Alex K.: on it, grabbing the recent traces/logs. which canary do you want to run this against? need the runbook link too.

Maya R.: canary is `canary-23` (3 small nodes, us-west-2). runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/hotfix-rollouts I ran a quick local load test — looks promising. test command I used: `ab -n 5000 -c 50 http://kv-proxy-canary-23.internal/api/ping`

deploy-bot: Deploy bot: Canary deployment queued for infra#4621 -> canary-23. status: queued

Priya S.: adding my review now. quick q — does this touch eviction/cleanup flows at all? want to make sure we don't increase background pressure.

Maya R.: no eviction changes; only connpool params revert (maxIdle + dial timeout). snippet: ```diff
- maxIdle: 8
- dialTimeout: 10ms
+ maxIdle: 16
+ dialTimeout: 50ms
```

Liam T.: LGTM from infra side. spun up the canary, ran smoke checks (redis ops rate, p95, cpu) — all look stable so far.

Alex K.: approving now. @Priya S. can you give a +1? we need one more approver to merge per policy.

Priya S.: ok +1. I'll watch metrics for the next 15m and will shout if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy bot: Canary deployment started for infra#4621 -> canary-23. status: in_progress

deploy-bot: Deploy bot: Canary deployment succeeded for infra#4621 -> canary-23. status: success

Maya R.: thanks all — merging the rollback PR now, then rolling out to prod with a 5-minute linear ramp. tagging oncall for visibility @oncall-bot

oncall-bot: Oncall: Noted. Alerting window open for 30m. Will notify #eng-sre if error rate > 3x baseline during the window.
__notes: Single-thread Slack conversation. Messages are chronological and prefixed by sender. No title field as per agents.md.
